fields.title: 📖 Imām ash-Shāfiʿī on Taḥākum: less than Shirk
fields.body:
🖋️ **ash-Shāfiʿī** said:

> ***“Leaving them upon that which is less than Shirk is all the more fitting, when we leave them upon the greater.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** ash-Shāfiʿī does not treat recourse to judges who judge by other than the truth as a Shirk ritual, but as a Fiqh question concerning Ahl adh-Dhimmah.

immutable.source: 📝 ash-Shāfiʿī, al-Umm, Kitāb al-Ḥudūd, Bāb Ḥadd adh-Dhimmiyyīn idhā zanaw, Bd. 6, S. 152/191 je nach Ausgabe.
